identification: Three salt-glazed stoneware storage jars: a large brown salt-glaze jar with a rolled rim (left, tallest ~36 cm), a small dark brown lidded jar (centre) with a loose separate stoneware lid, and a two-tone cream/tan Bristol-glaze jar with cork stopper (right, partly cut off in photo). Likely late 19th to early 20th century English or Australian kitchen/preserve jars, unmarked in photo.
